title: The Forgotten God
text: A little shrine to a god nobody remembers, overgrown with ivy, its idol worn to a smooth stub. The god is very small now, no bigger than a mouse, sitting on its own altar. It is very pleased to see anyone at all.

options.label: Leave the little god an offering, so that it is not quite forgotten.

outcomes.text: It does what little it can, so very grateful to be remembered.

options.label: The cleverest strikes a bargain with it, for whatever it has left to give.

outcomes.text: For a promise of remembrance it gives far more than it should. If you forget, it will know.

options.label: Break its shrine. A god that small can do no harm.

outcomes.text: A very small voice curses you. The curse is not small at all.
